content: Mike, do you want to go to the hospital and see Sam this afternoon?
What's happened to him? Is he ill?
No. Haven't you heard about it? He was hit by a car while he was riding his motorbike to school this morning.
Oh, I'm so sorry to hear that. I really knew nothing about it. I hope it's not serious.
It was sad that he rolled a few meters away before he stopped unconscious. Luckily, he was wearing his helmet, so his head was well protected.
Have they had him fully examined?
I really have no idea. I hope there aren't any internal injuries. So will you go?
